verdict.rationale: Meltano's marketing page claims 'Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts' and pipelines can be scheduled via Airflow with incremental state tracking, but there is no documentation describing freshness metrics per destination table or alerts specifically for missed cadence/SLA violations. missing for 10: docs on table-level freshness dashboards, cadence/SLA-based alerting configuration, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that monitoring or alerts actually work as described.
